definitions.gloss: severe winter; harsh winter; the coldest period of winter
definitions.explanation: refers to the harshest, coldest part of winter or an exceptionally cold winter

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳冬|げんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: This year looks like it will be a severe winter.

examples.japanese: {厳冬|げんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I traveled to Hokkaido in the harsh winter.

examples.japanese: {厳冬|げんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防寒対策|ぼうかんたいさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Cold weather measures are necessary to get through the harsh winter.

notes:
SEASONAL VOCABULARY:
{厳冬|げんとう} describes either:
1. The coldest part of winter (typically January-February in Japan)
2. An exceptionally severe winter season

RELATED SEASONAL TERMS:
- ⟦{初冬|しょとう}→初冬：08712_shotou⟧ - early winter
- ⟦{真冬|まふゆ}→真冬：20587_mafuyu⟧ - midwinter, depth of winter
- {晩冬|ばんとう} - late winter
- ⟦{暖冬|だんとう}→暖冬：21745_dantou⟧ - mild winter (opposite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厳冬|げんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ - to enter the harsh winter
- {厳冬|げんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧ - to get through the severe winter
- {厳冬|げんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} - during the severe winter (formal letter writing)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{厳寒|げんかん}→厳寒：20655_genkan⟧ - severe cold
- ⟦{極寒|ごっかん}→極寒：21345_gokkan⟧ - extreme cold
- ⟦{酷寒|こっかん}→酷寒：15568_kokkan⟧ - bitter cold
